articles.title: AI X-Ray Software Helps Detect Feeding Tube Position: GE HealthCare's 2026 Update
articles.summary: GE HealthCare's FDA-cleared Critical Care Suite 3.0 adds on-device AI assistance for feeding tube assessment on mobile X-rays for adults and children.

articles.title: Robotic Surgery in Karachi: JPMC Experience and Ziauddin's New Programme
articles.summary: A look at robotic-assisted surgery in Karachi, including JPMC's hospital-reported procedures and a Ziauddin Hospital Karachi programme announcement.

articles.title: New Diabetes Wearable Tracks Glucose and Ketones Together: FDA 2026 Authorization
articles.summary: The US FDA authorized Abbott's Libre Duo wearable for continuous glucose and ketone monitoring in people with diabetes aged 2 and older.

articles.title: Alzheimer's Blood Test: FDA Clears Roche pTau217 Assessment in 2026
articles.summary: Roche announced US FDA clearance of a pTau217 blood biomarker test to aid assessment in certain symptomatic adults aged 55 and over.

articles.title: New AI Assistant for CT and MRI Teams: GE HealthCare Imaging 360 Update
articles.summary: GE HealthCare announced AI-assisted protocoling and workflow features for CT and MRI teams, distinct from autonomous image diagnosis.

articles.title: US ARPA-H HARBOR Project: Up to $42 Million for Medical Imaging AI Research
articles.summary: ARPA-H lists an award of up to $42 million to support privacy-aware research with deidentified radiology and pathology imaging data.

articles.title: Dengue in Sindh: November 2026 Case Reports and Warning Signs
articles.summary: Karachi and Sindh dengue figures reported on 12 November are attributed to health department data cited by the press. Learn warning signs and prevention; not a live case count.
articles.sourceName: The Express Tribune (figures attributed to Sindh Health Department)

articles.title: Dog Bite and Rabies Prevention in Pakistan: What to Do Immediately
articles.summary: WHO guidance explains immediate wound washing for at least 15 minutes and urgent medical assessment for rabies vaccination or immunoglobulin.

articles.title: Sindh Polio Drive 2026: 7.104 Million Children Vaccinated in November
articles.summary: Pakistan's official polio programme reports about 7.104 million children vaccinated in 20 Sindh districts during the 2–8 November campaign.

articles.title: WHO Antibiotic Resistance Awareness Week 2026: Why Testing Matters
articles.summary: WHO's 2026 AMR update highlights persistent gaps in laboratory testing and prescribing guidance, alongside World AMR Awareness Week.

articles.title: Kidney Transplant at Ziauddin Hospital Sukkur: Private-Sector Milestone Reported
articles.summary: A Facebook announcement involving Dr. Naveed Ahmed Mahar reports a kidney transplant at Dr. Ziauddin Hospital Sukkur. The private-sector 'first' claim remains unverified; SIUT performed Sukkur transplants in 2019.
articles.imageAlt: Healthcare team photographed together at Dr. Ziauddin Hospital Sukkur

articles.title: GMMMC Teaching Hospital Sukkur Inaugurates Diabetic Foot and Renovated Orthopaedic Wards
articles.summary: Ghulam Muhammad Mahar Medical College Teaching Hospital Sukkur (formerly Civil Hospital Sukkur) inaugurated the diabetic foot and renovated orthopaedic wards on 18 November 2026. Principal Prof. Dr. Saleh Muhammad Channa, MS Dr. Ahmed Mujtabba and specialist doctors attended.
articles.hospitalName: Ghulam Muhammad Mahar Medical College Teaching Hospital Sukkur
articles.imageAlt: Orthopaedic Department inauguration plaque at GMMMC Hospital Sukkur, dated 18 November 2026

articles.title: Pelvic and Acetabular Fracture Surgery Reported at Sukkur Trauma Centre
articles.summary: A Facebook account describes pelvic and acetabular fracture surgery at Sukkur Trauma Centre, with named orthopaedic surgeons. The report has not been independently verified.
